title: Spicy Peanut Red Cabbage Slaw
changes_from_base: A peanut, ginger and chilli dressing coats red cabbage alone; no mayonnaise, soured cream or salting.
summary: A vibrant red cabbage slaw in a creamy peanut butter dressing with ginger, garlic and chilli, topped with spring onions.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
spring onions, thinly sliced on the diagonal

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the peanut butter, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, vinegar, chilli flakes and hot water in the bowl until creamy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the cabbage and salt and toss well until coated.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with spring onions and serve within a few hours.

tips: Use hot water to loosen the peanut butter quickly.
Best within a few hours of mixing, while the cabbage is crunchy.
Add crushed peanuts on top for extra crunch.
storage: Best on the day; keeps up to 1 day in the fridge but softens. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
